item.name: Scenario 04 (BVA Limit 1 - GPA): Lower and upper bounds (0.0, 4.0, -0.01, 4.01)
Scenario 05 (BVA Limit 2 - Course Capacity & Status Transition): Enrolling up to and beyond maxSize

exec: pm.test('2nd student added at capacity (200)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Adding student past maxSize returns 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

item.name: Scenario 06 (BVA Limit 3 - Student Name Length): 0, 1, 100, and 101 characters
Scenario 07 (BVA on Course Update): Reducing maxSize below current roster size
4. PUT Course with maxSize = 2 (On Roster Size Limit) -> 200

exec: pm.test('Setting maxSize equal to current roster (2) succeeds (200)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: 5. PUT Course with maxSize = 1 (Below Roster Size Limit) -> 400

exec: pm.test('Setting maxSize below current roster (1 < 2) fails (400)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));
